'''Saberhing Development Compact''' was a common subsidiary of [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] and [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saberhing/Legends|Saberhing]]. Corellia Mining Corporation was in charge of the mining, and CEC manufacturing [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The installation was protected by a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
